title: Matterbridge Ecobee plugin
description: Ecobee thermostats and room sensors. Register an app at https://www.ecobee.com/developers/ to obtain an API Key (client_id), then enter it below. On first start the plugin logs a 4-character PIN: enter it under your Ecobee account at https://www.ecobee.com/consumerportal/index.html (My Apps > Add Application). Tokens are persisted and refreshed automatically.

apiKey.title: Ecobee API Key (client_id)
apiKey.description: The API Key (client_id) of your registered Ecobee developer application using the ecobee PIN authorization (scope smartWrite).

exposeRoomSensors.title: Expose Room Sensors
exposeRoomSensors.description: Expose Ecobee remote room sensors as Matter temperature / occupancy / humidity sensors.

pollInterval.title: Poll Interval (seconds)
pollInterval.description: How often to poll the Ecobee cloud API for thermostat and sensor updates. Minimum 60 seconds.

whiteList.title: White List
whiteList.description: Only the devices in the list will be exposed. If the list is empty, all the devices will be exposed.

blackList.title: Black List
blackList.description: The devices in the list will not be exposed. If the list is empty, no devices will be excluded.

debug.title: Enable Debug
debug.description: Enable debug mode for the plugin. Only for debugging purposes, not recommended for production use.

unregisterOnShutdown.title: Unregister On Shutdown
unregisterOnShutdown.description: Unregister all devices on shutdown. Only for debugging purposes, not recommended for production use.
